zara: quick note from the sylph-v0 q4a bring-up — on the arabic->en eval shard we see tokens merging when theres a NBSP (U+00A0) between arabic words and latin segments. BLEU drops ~1.2 on that slice.

josh: can you paste a tiny repro? i want to see whether tokenization or detok is doing the merge.

zara: repro below, runs against the q4a canary. fp16 baseline keeps the NBSP, q4a output replaces it with regular space and sometimes concatenates adjacent words.

```
# repro (utf8 aware terminal)
echo -n "\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645\u00A0english" | ./infer --model sylph-v0 --quant q4a --input -
# output-q4a: \u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 english
# output-fp16: \u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645\u00A0english
```

li: tokenized ids pre-infer are identical across quant and fp16 when using our tokenizer binary, so this looks like post-gen normalization again (detok/service or console). i'll grep the canary logs.

eng-oncall-bot: [deploy] sylph-v0-q4a-canary -> scheduled on gpu-canary-05 :satellite:

josh: i checked the canary traces  detok-service v1.9 is used by the q4a workflow (pinned). that detok branch has a "normalize_nbsp" codepath that maps NBSP to SPACE for compatibility with downstream systems. seems unfortunate for RTL adjacency.

zara: ah that explains it. because NBSP behaves differently when adjacent to RTL characters (affects shaping/bracket mirroring too). when NBSP becomes SPACE, rendering and token boundaries shift.

li: opened a small script to fuzz surrounding contexts (arabic+nbspace+latin, arabic+nbspace+punct). repros are consistent. attaching token-level debug:

```
pre-tokens: ["\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645", "\u00A0", "english"]
post-detok-q4a: ["\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645", " ", "english"]
post-joined: ["\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645english"]
```

anya: good catch. if this is a pinned detok image problem, we need to: (1) make a hotfix to detok to preserve NBSP when adjacent to RTL; (2) patch the q4a canary manifest to point to the fixed image; (3) add a locale-smoke that includes NBSP cases to the quant bring-up checklist.

josh: filed detok PR #501 to add a preserve_nbsp_for_rtl flag + unit tests. also added a regression test for arabic+nbsp+latin.

qa-bot: [CI] detok PR #501 run: 18 tests, 2 flaky skipped, 1 failing (captured) 

li: the failing test is due to an unrelated normalization helper, fixing now. once tests green we can update the canary.

eng-oncall-bot: [deploy] sylph-v0-q4a-canary -> patching detok image to redwood/detok:2025-01-patch501

zara: re-ran the eval after patch  BLEU on the arabic->en slice recovers to baseline (0.05 delta). rendering checks look normal (no bracket mirror flips).

josh: follow-ups: add NBSP/ZWSP/THINSPACE samples to the multilingual dev bundle; ensure the quant onboarding doc has a note about pinned postprocess images; add a simple lint in infra manifests that flags detok versions older than main.

anya: agree. also flagging for product that locales with mixed-script adjacency are high-risk for whitespace normalization. we should add this to the onboarding risk matrix.

li: CI now shows detok PR #501 passing after fix. merging shortly.

qa-bot: [CI] detok PR #501 passed  19 tests :white_check_mark:

zara: thanks everyone. marking as resolved for sylph q4a NBSP regression. will reopen if we see similar for other scripts. :thumbsup:
